node.title: H3 quotient-orbit Taylor cutoff ladder
node.statement: For every canonical quotient block and cutoff c>=2, the odd coefficient content of Res_T(q_O,sum_(i=0)^c Pcal_n^[i](T)X^i) has exactly the prime radical of the cutoff-c scalar annihilator. These supports descend with c, so any c<=35 is a complete cutoff-35 superset. At n=8192, c=2 exactly screens quotient-supported triple product collisions with 24,534 blocks, maximum X-degree 8,192 and total possible X-degree 134,168,580; exact row filtering removes multiplicities 3 through 35. No optimal-cutoff, implementation, factorization, resource, moment, or C36 bound is claimed.
